brief: The official site is live (HTTP 200) and serving “CUPI | Cornell Physical Intelligence at Cornell University.” On a search snapshot from Aug 21, 2026 · 12:50 PM EDT — not Google Search Console — cornellphysicalintelligence.com ranks in 12 of 20 tracked queries, averaging position 2.5 where it appears, and is missing from the other 8. The wiki is in 0 of 20. Campus Groups and the GitHub org take most of the #1 slots; the Cornell Parole Initiative still shows up on the short CUPI names. The bare query “CUPI” belongs to Cisco’s API and an Indian fintech — the club does not appear. The wiki URL itself does not rank, because the public page is a Google login wall. Wiki pull request #1 would add crawlable landing prose; it is not merged yet.

updates.website: Website is up (HTTP 200) and the live title is “CUPI | Cornell Physical Intelligence at Cornell University.” The latest change was: Add the team wiki to the Organization entity graph. No open pull requests. It ranks on 12 of 20 queries (average 2.5 when present) and is not in results for the other 8, including the bare acronym and the project queries.
updates.wiki: Wiki is up (HTTP 200) and the live title is “CUPI Wiki | Cornell Physical Intelligence.” The public URL is a Google login wall, so a crawler has no public copy to rank. The latest change was: Reconnecting heals a From address that no verified domain can carry. It is not in results for any of the 20 tracked queries (0/20). Open pull request #1 — public crawlable landing — is not merged yet.

ranks.disclaimer: Search-index snapshot, not Google Search Console. Positions are among returned web results. Never invent a missing rank.

The wiki URL itself does not rank.
ECE 4760 hexapod is 4, not a CUPI project page.
CUAD and CUAir own drone queries. Campus Groups 5.
Official site missed. CEI lab 2, CAM 3.
